where.t: Word study: From duct to education

sum.m: out: Latin ex-, written e- before l, d and some other consonants
lead, bring up: Latin duc-, in ēducāre, to bring up, and dux, ducis, a leader
makes a doing word: make, do (designate, educate); or a Latin past form, in a describing word (separate)
